headword: {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}

definitions.gloss: socially adept; street-smart; good at getting along in life
definitions.explanation: skilled at navigating social situations and advancing in life through interpersonal savvy

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}だ。
{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧しやすい。
examples.english: Socially savvy people tend to advance in their careers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不器用|ぶきよう}→不器用：06642_bukiyou⟧な⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はなれない。
examples.english: I'm too clumsy to ever be socially adept.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{世渡|よわた}り→世渡り：07736_yowatari⟧ (getting along in the world) + ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ (skilled at)

USAGE:
- Can be admiring: "they know how to get ahead"
- Can be critical: "they're calculating" or "opportunistic"
- Implies knowing when to flatter, compromise, and network

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず} ↔ ⟦{不器用|ぶきよう}→不器用：06642_bukiyou⟧ (socially clumsy)
- {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず} ↔ ⟦{世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}→世渡り下手：25525_yowataribeta⟧ (poor at social navigation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
~⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ pattern (skilled at ~):
- ⟦{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}→話し上手：08467_hanashijouzu⟧ - good at speaking
- ⟦{聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}→聞き上手：08468_kikijouzu⟧ - good at listening
- ⟦{甘|あま}え{上手|じょうず}→甘え上手：08495_amaejouzu⟧ - good at acting spoiled

RELATED WORDS:
